scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: bash -c 'set -a; test -f ../.env && . ../.env; set +a; export DATABASE_URL="${EDUCATION_TARGET_DATABASE_URL:-${EDUCATION_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}}"; exec npx prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.prisma:validate: bash -c 'set -a; test -f ../.env && . ../.env; set +a; export DATABASE_URL="${EDUCATION_TARGET_DATABASE_URL:-${EDUCATION_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}}"; exec npx prisma validate'
